description: Ask a question, get a short answer with numbered citations [1], [2] and the source list. Searches Wikipedia and our own news index (GDELT and Hacker News, last 7 days), reads the top 3 pages and answers only from them with Claude Haiku 5.5; when the sources do not answer the question it says so. source auto (current events go to news first), news or web (Wikipedia); optional answer language. Not a general web index: niche or very new topics may have no sources, then the call is not charged. Price: $0.008 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"question":"What is a Legal Entity Identifier used for?"}.

language.description: Answer language, e.g. German; default English
